## Description

Encounter step "Consent": show consent script in the chosen language (English/Tamil/Hindi; Arabic for UAE) for the doctor to read; record decision given/declined, by whom (patient, guardian), people in the room (ENCOUNTER_PARTICIPANT), device choice (this phone with mic test, desk microphone, clip disabled until P6). Decline → manual note (E-04) with "No recording for this visit. You can write the note manually." and no guilt copy. Consent pill in the banner.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Recording cannot start without a "given" consent receipt for this encounter (server-enforced; FSM CONSENT_VERIFIED).
- [ ] **AC2.** 100 % of recording sessions reference a consent receipt (database constraint + test; exit gate 3).
- [ ] **AC3.** Declined path leads to the manual note with the same sign flow (Playwright test).
- [ ] **AC4.** Consent is per encounter; treatment consent at registration never implies recording consent.
- [ ] **AC5.** Microphone permission denial shows guidance and offers manual note.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
